Built with R version `r getRversion()`

Note: this script is intended to be run directly (e.g. via `knitr::purl()` +
`source()`, or by running chunks interactively) rather than rendered to a
report. Each panel is saved as its own PDF under `results/Supplementary_Figure_2/`
so it can be compared directly against the manuscript figure.

## Setup {.tabset}

### Environment
```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
gc()

# Establish working directory (repo root)
if (!is.null(knitr::current_input())) {
  setwd(dirname(knitr::current_input()))
  setwd("..")
}

# Output directory (absolute path, robust to knitr working-directory changes)
output.base <- normalizePath("results/Supplementary_Figure_2", mustWork = FALSE)
if (!dir.exists(output.base)) {
  dir.create(output.base, recursive = TRUE)
}

LoadSeuratRds <- function(file) readRDS(file)

library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(SeuratExtend)

# Load preprocessed Seurat objects from saves/
# Data should be downloaded from Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21391578) into saves/
cd45pos.seurat <- LoadSeuratRds("saves/CD45pos_seurat.rds")
cd45neg.seurat <- LoadSeuratRds("saves/CD45neg_seurat.rds")

cat("Data loaded. CD45pos:", dim(cd45pos.seurat), "| CD45neg:", dim(cd45neg.seurat), "\n")
```

### Gene Signatures
```{r gene_signatures}

# ISG panel: curated Type I interferon-stimulated genes
isg.genes <- c(
  # Core ISGs
  "Isg15", "Ifit1", "Ifit2", "Ifit3", "Irf7", "Stat1", "Stat2", "Oas1a",
  "Mx2", "Rsad2", "Usp18", "Ifi44", "Ifi44l", "Oasl1", "Gbp2", "Cxcl10",
  # Canonical Hallmark ISGs
  "Ifih1", "Ifi27", "Ifi27l2b", "Ifi30", "Ifi35", "Ifitm1", "Ifitm2", "Ifitm3",
  "Isg20", "Ddx60", "Eif2ak2", "Ly6e", "Oas1g", "Parp12", "Parp14", "Rtp4",
  # Pattern-recognition/signalling
  "Ddx58", "Oas1b", "Oas2", "Oas3", "Oasl2"
)

# cGAS/STING signaling pathway genes
cgas.genes <- c(
  "Cgas", "Ifi204", "Ddx41", "Tmem173", "Tbk1", "Ikbke", "Irf3", "Irf7",
  "Nfkb1", "Rela", "Trex1", "Enpp1", "Ifnb1", "Il6", "Tnf", "Cxcl10",
  "Ccl2", "Ccl5", "Aim2", "Pycard", "Casp1"
)

cat("ISG panel:", length(isg.genes), "genes\n")
cat("cGAS/STING panel:", length(cgas.genes), "genes\n")
```

### Prepare CD45+ (Myeloid) Subset
```{r prepare_cd45pos}

# Subset to Day 4 and keep only myeloid populations
myeloid.keep <- c("DC", "Macrophages", "Monocytes", "Neutrophils")
Idents(cd45pos.seurat) <- cd45pos.seurat@meta.data$Time
cd45pos.d4 <- subset(cd45pos.seurat, idents = "Day4")

Idents(cd45pos.d4) <- cd45pos.d4@meta.data$cell_type
cd45pos.d4 <- subset(cd45pos.d4, idents = myeloid.keep)

DefaultAssay(cd45pos.d4) <- "SCT"
cd45pos.d4$Treatment <- factor(cd45pos.d4$Treatment, levels = c("Vehicle", "PDS"))
cd45pos.d4$cell_type <- factor(cd45pos.d4$cell_type, levels = myeloid.keep)

# Desired column/group order for heatmaps and violin plots: Vehicle block then PDS block
myeloid.col.order <- c("DC_Vehicle", "Macrophages_Vehicle", "Monocytes_Vehicle", "Neutrophils_Vehicle",
                       "DC_PDS", "Macrophages_PDS", "Monocytes_PDS", "Neutrophils_PDS")

cat("CD45pos Day4 myeloid cells:", dim(cd45pos.d4), "\n")
print(table(cd45pos.d4$cell_type, cd45pos.d4$Treatment))
```

### Prepare CD45- (Tumor + Fibroblast) Subset
```{r prepare_cd45neg}

DefaultAssay(cd45neg.seurat) <- "SCT"

# Collapse tumor clusters into a single "Tumor" category; keep Fibroblasts as-is
cd45neg.seurat$cell_type <- ifelse(
  grepl("^Tumor", cd45neg.seurat$cluster_anno),
  "Tumor",
  as.character(cd45neg.seurat$cluster_anno)
)

cd45neg.d4 <- subset(cd45neg.seurat, subset = cell_type %in% c("Tumor", "Fibroblasts"))

cd45neg.d4$Treatment <- factor(cd45neg.d4$Treatment, levels = c("Vehicle", "PDS"))
cd45neg.d4$cell_type <- factor(cd45neg.d4$cell_type, levels = c("Tumor", "Fibroblasts"))

# Desired column/group order: Tumor_Vehicle, Fibroblasts_Vehicle, Tumor_PDS, Fibroblasts_PDS
cd45neg.col.order <- c("Tumor_Vehicle", "Fibroblasts_Vehicle", "Tumor_PDS", "Fibroblasts_PDS")

cat("CD45neg Day4 tumor/fibroblast cells:", dim(cd45neg.d4), "\n")
print(table(cd45neg.d4$cell_type, cd45neg.d4$Treatment))
```

### Helper: ordered pseudobulk heatmap (DoHeatmap, matches manuscript style)
```{r heatmap_helper}

# Pseudobulk + DoHeatmap with a blue-white-red2 diverging scale (matches
# scripts/04_CD45Pos_Manuscript_plots.Rmd), forcing Vehicle-then-PDS column
# order (no row or column clustering - DoHeatmap does not cluster by default).
plot_pseudobulk_heatmap <- function(seu, features, group.by, col.order, title) {
  pseudo <- AggregateExpression(
    seu,
    assays = "SCT",
    return.seurat = TRUE,
    group.by = group.by
  )

  features.present <- intersect(features, rownames(pseudo))
  col.order <- col.order[col.order %in% colnames(pseudo)]

  # Force group/column order: DoHeatmap orders by Idents() factor levels,
  # not by physical column order, so the identity factor must be releveled.
  Idents(pseudo) <- factor(Idents(pseudo), levels = col.order)
  pseudo <- pseudo[, col.order]

  p <- DoHeatmap(
    pseudo,
    features = features.present,
    draw.lines = FALSE,
    angle = 90,
    raster = FALSE
  ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red2") +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title)

  list(plot = p, n.features = length(features.present), n.total = length(features))
}
```

## Supplementary Figure 2: ISG Signature

### Panel a: ISG heatmap - Myeloid
```{r isg_heatmap_myeloid}

res <- plot_pseudobulk_heatmap(
  cd45pos.d4, isg.genes, c("cell_type", "Treatment"), myeloid.col.order,
  "ISG Signature - Myeloid Cells"
)
cat("ISG genes present in myeloid:", res$n.features, "/", res$n.total, "\n")

pdf(file.path(output.base, "SupFig2a_ISG_heatmap_myeloid.pdf"), width = 8, height = 9)
print(res$plot)
dev.off()
print(res$plot)
```

### Panel b: ISG heatmap - CD45- (Tumor + Fibroblasts)
```{r isg_heatmap_cd45neg}

res <- plot_pseudobulk_heatmap(
  cd45neg.d4, isg.genes, c("cell_type", "Treatment"), cd45neg.col.order,
  "ISG Signature - Tumor & Fibroblasts"
)
cat("ISG genes present in CD45-:", res$n.features, "/", res$n.total, "\n")

pdf(file.path(output.base, "SupFig2b_ISG_heatmap_CD45neg.pdf"), width = 6, height = 9)
print(res$plot)
dev.off()
print(res$plot)
```

### Panel c: ISG module score violin - Myeloid
```{r isg_module_score_myeloid}

isg.present <- intersect(isg.genes, rownames(cd45pos.d4))
cd45pos.d4 <- AddModuleScore(
  cd45pos.d4,
  features = list(isg.present),
  name = "ISG",
  assay = "SCT"
)
cd45pos.d4$ISG_score <- cd45pos.d4$ISG1
cd45pos.d4$ISG1 <- NULL

p.isg.vln.myeloid <- VlnPlot2(
  cd45pos.d4,
  features = "ISG_score",
  group.by = "cell_type",
  split.by = "Treatment",
  stat.method = "wilcox.test",
  p.adjust.method = "holm",
  label = "p.signif",
  hide.ns = TRUE,
  pt = FALSE
) +
  labs(title = "ISG Module Score - Myeloid Cells", y = "ISG Score", x = "Cell Type")

ggsave(file.path(output.base, "SupFig2c_ISG_violin_myeloid.pdf"),
       p.isg.vln.myeloid, width = 10, height = 6, units = "in")
print(p.isg.vln.myeloid)
```
